title: safety.viz portfolio manifest
description: The shape of src/data/portfolio.json: the standard domain set a study supplies, and for every chart module the domains it reads and the column each of its settings defaults to. Unlike its neighbours in this directory, this is not a chart's data contract; it describes the manifest that sits across all of them.

version.description: Manifest format version; raised when the shape below changes.

domains.description: The standard domain set, keyed by domain id.

modules.description: Every chart module, keyed by its module name (the name of its data schema file).

demo.description: The vendored demo extract under site/data/ that supplies this domain.

columns.description: The domain's columns, keyed by the default column name the modules expect.

export.description: The name the module is exported under from src/main.js.

domains.description: The standard domains the module cannot draw without. Empty only for a module that reads none of them.

optionalDomains.description: Standard domains the module uses when supplied.

externalDomains.description: Domains the module reads that are outside the standard set, named as its own data schema names them. A module that lists any maps no settings here.

settings.description: The module's column-name settings, keyed as in its data schema; a nested setting is written with a dot (color.value_col).

domain.description: The domain the column is read from; a list when the same setting names a column in more than one table.

column.description: The manifest column the setting defaults to; null when the module's schema gives the setting no default.

required.description: Whether the module's schema lists the setting as required.
